findings.note: Jets team site (Oct 16) says New York has the NFL's 4th-ranked pass defense, allowing about 175 passing yards per game and the 7th-fewest downfield passing yards per Next Gen Stats; this team-published source calls for more pass-rush aggression against Maye.

Covers analyst Ed Scimia picks Maye over on an alternate line of 225+ passing yards, below this 246.5 line, citing 643 yards over his last two games and expecting a close game; he ranks the Jets only 12th in EPA per pass.

From the Week 5 game: New England was already without WR A.J. Brown, CB Christian Gonzalez and RG Mike Onwenu, and LT Will Campbell (knee) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) left the game; their status for the Jets game was not confirmed in the results found.
